suggestions: suggestions from the 32-club depth-chart sweep (verdicts left blank)

items.suggestion: Treat the depth sweep as a weekly snapshot pipeline: re-capture all 32 clubs each week (IND already republishes weekly; LV/CHI/TEN/SF/GB state dated charts), storing one dated snapshot per club per week rather than a single moving register
items.rationale: Depth charts are point-in-time; a single capture silently goes stale as rosters move (evidenced by the 5 reserve-list stale-depth flags found within days of capture)

items.suggestion: For the backup-deficiency feature, consume replacement depth (recorded in roster_ir_sweep.json) for every stale-depth flagged cell instead of the flagged rank1 name, or exclude flagged cells from the feature's inputs
items.rationale: 6 stale-depth cells were found (LAC Derwin James Jr. S1; LAR Puka Nacua WR1; LAR Jordan Whittington KR1; TEN Peter Skoronski LG1; TEN Tommy Townsend P1/H1); using them unflagged would misstate the current depth order

items.suggestion: Track HOU as an open action item: request or locate a machine-readable official Houston depth surface (text table, API, or official data feed) before trusting any Houston depth cell
items.rationale: HOU is the only club whose official depth route publishes an image; every other club is text-verified, so HOU is the single remaining unverified row in the register

items.suggestion: Add the 17 confirmed official domains (data/teams.json) as the canonical domain map for all future NFL club fetches — short-form domains are unreliable (bills.com is a finance site, eagles.com a shopify shop, falcons.com a shop, cardinals.com MLB, and ravens/cowboys/rams/titans/bears/lions/saints/jets/dolphins/browns .com variants 500 or wrong surface)
items.rationale: Every failed route this session was a domain-surface problem, not a route problem; the corrected map removes the class of failure

items.suggestion: Preserve shared-rank-slot cells as primary+alt in every downstream model rather than picking one name, and never infer an order between them
items.rationale: 13 clubs use shared slots; collapsing to a single name loses official information and forces an unsupported ordering

items.suggestion: Keep the parsed artefacts (data/parsed/*.json) as the single source for team-level models, with the register as the human-readable projection (rank1-rank3)
items.rationale: The register drops rank 4+ and special-teams detail; models that need full depth should read the parsed files to avoid silent truncation
